result_free_lock.permitted_contents: design choices and accepted analytic expectations only
result_free_lock.mutation_rule: Any semantic plan change requires a new version and a new independent V-071 review before production execution.

scope.claim_boundary: Trajectory evidence may support the preregistered finite active case and named headline contrasts; it does not prove continuum-wide formulas, exact protocol equivalence, novelty, a higher-order result, or any unlisted limit.
excluded_work: small-step Bernoulli resetting as a truth implementation
reuse of S-011 or S-012 stochastic pilot data
post hoc sample-size changes, top-ups, retries, tier changes, window changes, or tolerance changes

locked_model.event_semantics: Sample exponential reset times exactly, integrate to each event by splitting the current step, record the pre-reset state, apply the fixed map without advancing time, then continue from the post-reset state.

independence.method_family: direct stochastic paths with exact Poisson clocks and transparent Euler-Maruyama between events
forbidden_trajectory_kernel_imports: any moment operator or moment ODE
independence.reference_isolation_rule: The reference adapter may be loaded only after trajectory summaries, path hashes, paired differences, windows, and uncertainty inputs are frozen. It is never imported by the trajectory kernel.

parameter_cases.purpose: All-seven finite active case for the minimal spatial classifier, internal-sector identities, drift, contracted-observation degeneracy, and separating spatial witness.

numerical_schedule.fine_coarse_rule: Every coarse Wiener increment is the sum of the corresponding fine increments. Both paths use the same sampled reset times and are flushed at every reset before applying the map.
numerical_schedule.event_order: integrate segment ending at event; record pre-reset state; reset at the same time; record post-reset state

sampling.fixed_count_rule: Run exactly the declared count once. If a required comparison is unresolved, do not add trajectories; stop and record unresolved.

seed_policy.chunk_stream_rule: For chunk index k starting at zero, use stream_code=declared_protocol_stream_code+k. Chunk boundaries and order are fixed.
seed_policy.main_protocol_coupling: All seven main runs use the same stream code, so reset clocks and Wiener increments are shared across protocols and disclosed as common random numbers.
seed_policy.unpaired_rule: Each of the six protocols needed by H2-H4 uses a distinct base seed. No reset clock or Wiener stream is shared across the protocols being confirmed.
seed_policy.clean_room_rule: The reserved seed is not used by production and does not authorize clean-room execution.

stationary_internal_observables.estimator: For each trajectory, average mean_squared_speed over the primary late window; then use the trajectory mean. H3 separately hashes every recorded v and theta value for its three pathwise internal-sector checks.
stationary_internal_observables.uncertainty: trajectory-level sample standard error with the declared tier quantile

observables: stationary centered spatial covariance trace for P, PV, PTheta, and PVTheta
raw mean_squared_displacement for the PV/PVTheta H4 contrast only
mean_position_dot_velocity for the PV/PVTheta H4 contrast only
localized_spatial_observables.estimator: Average the ensemble statistic over the primary late window, treating complete trajectories as independent units.
localized_spatial_observables.uncertainty: whole-trajectory bootstrap-SE normal-equivalent interval with fixed replicate-block stability diagnostic

transport_observables.estimator: Mean velocity is a late-window trajectory mean. D_eff is one quarter of the least-squares slope of the ensemble centered covariance trace in the primary window.
transport_observables.uncertainty: D_eff uses a whole-trajectory bootstrap estimate of the standard error and the fixed tier normal-equivalent quantile; naive repeated-time OLS standard errors are prohibited.

late_time_windows.B_window: max over the two nonprimary admissible windows of abs(estimate_window-estimate_primary)

bootstrap_se_stability.failure_outcome: unresolved unless another required check is contradicted

uncertainty_and_systematic_envelopes.bootstrap_replicate_justification: The interval uses the tier's fixed analytic normal-equivalent quantile and bootstrap only to estimate the whole-trajectory standard error, so no empirical 99% or 99.73% tail quantile is estimated. With 2048 fixed replicates, the idealized relative Monte Carlo standard error of a standard-deviation estimate is approximately 1/sqrt(2*(2048-1)) = 0.01563. Four fixed 512-replicate blocks must each yield an SE within 10% of the full-replicate SE; failure is unresolved and does not authorize more replicates.
uncertainty_and_systematic_envelopes.bootstrap_unit: complete matched trajectory for paired calculations; complete independent trajectory for direct calculations
uncertainty_and_systematic_envelopes.bootstrap_algorithm: For each exact multinomial trajectory resample, use count weights on per-trajectory (r_x,r_y,|r|^2) values at every recorded time. Recompute the ensemble means and centered covariance curve exactly from those weighted sufficient features, then recompute the declared window statistic. Fine/coarse pairs use the same weights. Process at most eight resamples at once; never copy a full (time,N,2) array per replicate.
uncertainty_and_systematic_envelopes.D_eff_interval: two-sided whole-trajectory bootstrap-SE interval using the fixed tier normal-equivalent quantile
uncertainty_and_systematic_envelopes.stationary_variance_interval: two-sided whole-trajectory bootstrap-SE interval using the fixed tier normal-equivalent quantile
uncertainty_and_systematic_envelopes.B_disc: For each target, compute the paired fine-minus-coarse estimate and its matched interval. Use max(abs(lower),abs(upper)) as the nonnegative discretization envelope.
uncertainty_and_systematic_envelopes.separation: Monte Carlo uncertainty, B_window, and B_disc are recorded separately and are never pooled into one standard error.

headline_comparisons.target: Position-reset protocols validate finite stationary centered variance; non-position protocols validate finite positive centered D_eff.
Validate each late mean velocity against its accepted analytic reference and validate the nonzero Theta-minus-V and VTheta-minus-V x-drift contrasts.
headline_comparisons.unpaired_confirmation: Recompute the two named drift differences from smaller protocol-independent streams using independent-sample uncertainty.

headline_comparisons.target: With shared clocks and Wiener paths, every recorded v and theta value must agree pathwise within 1e-12; selected nonzero internal moments are also compared to the common analytic reference.
headline_comparisons.unpaired_confirmation: On distinct protocol streams, compute each same-estimand speed difference with independent-sample uncertainty against the exact common nonzero reference difference.

headline_comparisons.target: The three named contractions validate against their common analytic references while the centered spatial covariance traces validate against distinct references.
headline_comparisons.unpaired_confirmation: Recompute the three equal-contraction differences and the centered-variance separating difference on distinct smaller streams with independent-sample uncertainty.

resource_estimate.position_bootstrap_analyses: 7 main direct whole-trajectory analyses, 1 main H4 paired centered-variance contrast, and 1 unpaired H4 centered-variance contrast
resource_estimate.peak_memory_rule: Analyze bounded protocol files and keep bootstrap batch size at eight; fail before the attempt sentinel and all stochastic work if locked arithmetic, free storage, or available memory differs from the preregistered floor.
resource_estimate.resource_scope: Planning estimate from locked counts and shapes only; it contains no trajectory or pilot result.

comparison_rules.symmetry_zero: Use the registered parent-moment scale and disable the relative term.
comparison_rules.derived_trace_scale_departure: For a preregistered trace of a raw matrix, use the sum of the registered diagonal component scales; this departure is fixed before results.
comparison_rules.paired_difference_se: sample_sd(trajectory_level_fine_minus_coarse_difference)/sqrt(N), or a matched whole-trajectory bootstrap for nonlinear centered statistics
comparison_rules.aggregate: Contradicted if any required central comparison is contradicted; otherwise unresolved if any required comparison, unpaired confirmation, provenance check, or discretization check is unresolved; validated only if every required item validates.

fail_closed_execution.audit_acceptance_marker_template: S-070_AUDIT_ACCEPTANCE {"disposition":"PASS","plan_id":"S-070-all-seven-trajectory-validation-primary-v1","plan_raw_sha256":"<runner-validated canonical raw hash>","plan_semantic_sha256":"<runner-validated semantic hash>","plan_version":"2.0.0","reviewed_manifest_sha256":"<runner-validated canonical source-manifest hash>"}
fail_closed_execution.audit_record_rule: Exactly one header, one exact PASS disposition, and one canonical standalone structured marker immediately below the header are required. Quoted, fenced, duplicated, malformed, REVISE, or stale records are rejected.
fail_closed_execution.source_state: Production requires a clean committed source tree and records the full commit plus canonical-LF source manifest and digest.
fail_closed_execution.reviewed_source_canonicalization: strict UTF-8 without BOM; normalize CRLF and lone CR to LF before SHA-256
fail_closed_execution.attempt_rule: After every deterministic gate and resource preflight passes, create the sentinel exclusively and fsync it immediately before the first stochastic draw. Never remove or replace it; any crash therefore prohibits silent retry.
stop_before_any_run_when: V-071 strict PASS record is absent, duplicated, malformed, quoted, fenced, REVISE, or any bound hash differs
contract, registry, schema, reviewed validator, or .gitattributes lock differs
stop_during_or_after_run_when: a count, seed, window, step, cap, tier, or tolerance differs
a top-up, retry, alternate output, or second final evaluation is attempted

commands.current_stage_prohibition: Do not run the production command during S-070.
